runtime: ISO/IEC 9899:2024 C standard library (WG14 N3220 working draft)

official_documentation_checked.finding: The listed standard headers provide no HTTP request parser.
FILE, fopen and fread provide bytes only; they do not return HTTP method, target, version or headers.

limit: Scoped to the ISO C standard library. No standard format-aware HTTP/1.1 API was documented to run.
